objective: Reproduce historical feature selection, then compare fixed36 with fixed66 LR and both Poisson fusions on identical six-season fixtures.
feature_policy: Fixed exact window_10_only columns in all six outer seasons; never replace by yearly selected features.

poisson.grid_policy: adaptive from predicted lambdas; common grid for all three score models

bootstrap.primary: paired date clusters stratified by test season
bootstrap.sensitivity: paired test-season clusters; only six clusters

limitation: Fixed36 was selected using later historical seasons. Six-season fixed36 evaluation is retrospective, not six independent feature-selection holdouts. 2025-26 follows the original selection interval but has already been inspected.
